description.en:
Basic Attack

Encore performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.

Basic Attack: Wooly Strike

After Basic Attack 4, press the Normal Attack button to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack

Encore consumes STA to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Encore consumes STA to perform a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing Fusion DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Encore melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Fusion DMG.

Basic Attack: Wooly Strike

Setelah Basic Attack 4, tekan tombol Normal Attack untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack

Encore mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Encore mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Mid-Air Plunging Attack, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

description.en:
Flaming Woolies

Encore summons Cloudy and Cosmos to attack with burning rays, dealing Fusion DMG.

Energetic Welcome

After casting Flaming Woolies, use Resonance Skill to perform Energetic Welcome, dealing Fusion DMG.
description.id:
Flaming Woolies

Encore memanggil Cloudy dan Cosmos untuk menyerang dengan sinar membara, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Energetic Welcome

Setelah Flaming Woolies dilancarkan, gunakan Resonance Skill untuk melakukan Energetic Welcome, memberikan Fusion DMG.

description.en:
As Encore loses control, Cosmos breaks free and wreaks havoc on its surroundings.

Basic Attack: Cosmos - Frolicking

During Cosmos Rave, the Basic Attack is replaced with Cosmos - Frolicking, which performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.

Cosmos: Heavy Attack

During Cosmos Rave, the Heavy Attack is replaced with Cosmos - Heavy Attack, consuming STA to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

Resonance Skill: Cosmos - Rampage

During Cosmos Rave, Flaming Woolies is replaced with Cosmos - Rampage, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.

Cosmos: Dodge Counter

During Cosmos Rave, use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.
description.id:
Saat Encore kehilangan kendali, Cosmos terlepas dan mengamuk di sekitarnya.

Basic Attack: Cosmos - Frolicking

Selama Cosmos Rave, Basic Attack digantikan oleh Cosmos - Frolicking, yang melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

Cosmos: Heavy Attack

Selama Cosmos Rave, Heavy Attack digantikan oleh Cosmos - Heavy Attack, mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.

Resonance Skill: Cosmos - Rampage

Selama Cosmos Rave, Flaming Woolies digantikan oleh Cosmos - Rampage, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.

Cosmos: Dodge Counter

Selama Cosmos Rave, gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

description.en: During the Resonance Liberation Cosmos Rave, when Encore's HP is above 70%, DMG dealt is increased by 10%.
description.id: Selama Resonance Liberation Cosmos Rave, saat HP Encore di atas 70%, DMG yang diberikan meningkat sebesar 10%.

description.en: When Resonance Skill Flaming Woolies or Resonance Skill Cosmos - Rampage is cast, Encore's Fusion DMG Bonus is increased by 10% for 10s.
description.id: Saat Resonance Skill Flaming Woolies atau Resonance Skill Cosmos - Rampage dilancarkan, Fusion DMG Bonus Encore meningkat sebesar 10% selama 10 dtk.

description.en: Encore pounces at the enemies with Cosmos, dealing Fusion DMG.
description.id: Encore menerkam musuh bersama Cosmos, memberikan Fusion DMG.

description.en:
Heavy Attack: Cloudy Frenzy

When Encore's "Mayhem" is full, after casting a Heavy Attack, Encore will consume all "Mayhem" to enter the Mayhem state, reducing damage taken by 70%. Switching Characters does not interrupt the Mayhem state.
After the Mayhem state ends, Encore will cast Cloudy Frenzy, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation damage.

Heavy Attack: Cosmos Rupture

During Cosmos Rave, when casting Heavy Attack, if "Mayhem" is full, Encore will consume all "Mayhem" to enter Cosmos' Mayhem state, reducing damage taken by 70%. Switching Characters does not interrupt the Cosmos' Mayhem state.
After Cosmos' Mayhem state ends, Encore will cast Cosmos Rupture, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

Mayhem

Encore can hold up to 100 "Mayhem".
When Normal Attack Wooly Attack hits a target, Encore restores "Mayhem".
When Resonance Skill Flaming Woolies hits a target, Encore restores "Mayhem".
When Resonance Skill Energetic Welcome hits a target, Encore restores "Mayhem".
When Intro Skill Woolies Helpers hits a target, Encore restores "Mayhem".
During the duration of Resonance Liberation Cosmos Rave, Encore restores "Mayhem" when hitting a target.
description.id:
Heavy Attack: Cloudy Frenzy

Saat "Mayhem" Encore penuh, setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack, Encore akan mengonsumsi seluruh "Mayhem" untuk memasuki state Mayhem, mengurangi damage yang diterima sebesar 70%. Berganti Karakter tidak menghentikan state Mayhem.
Setelah state Mayhem berakhir, Encore akan melancarkan Cloudy Frenzy, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai damage Resonance Liberation.

Heavy Attack: Cosmos Rupture

Selama Cosmos Rave, saat melancarkan Heavy Attack, jika "Mayhem" penuh, Encore akan mengonsumsi seluruh "Mayhem" untuk memasuki state Mayhem milik Cosmos, mengurangi damage yang diterima sebesar 70%. Berganti Karakter tidak menghentikan state Mayhem milik Cosmos.
Setelah state Mayhem milik Cosmos berakhir, Encore akan melancarkan Cosmos Rupture, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.

Mayhem

Encore dapat menyimpan hingga 100 "Mayhem".
Saat Normal Attack Wooly Attack mengenai target, Encore memulihkan "Mayhem".
Saat Resonance Skill Flaming Woolies mengenai target, Encore memulihkan "Mayhem".
Saat Resonance Skill Energetic Welcome mengenai target, Encore memulihkan "Mayhem".
Saat Intro Skill Woolies Helpers mengenai target, Encore memulihkan "Mayhem".
Selama durasi Resonance Liberation Cosmos Rave, Encore memulihkan "Mayhem" saat mengenai target.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: Encore generates a Thermal Field centered around skill target, with a radius of 3m. Targets inside the Thermal Field are continuously burned, suffering Fusion DMG equal to 176.76% of Encore's ATK every 1.5s for 6s.
description.id: Encore menciptakan Thermal Field berpusat pada target skill, dengan radius 3m. Target di dalam Thermal Field terus terbakar, menerima Fusion DMG sebesar 176,76% ATK Encore setiap 1,5 dtk selama 6 dtk.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: When Basic Attack hits a target, Encore's Fusion DMG Bonus is increased by 3%, stacking up to 4 time(s) for 6s.
description.id: Saat Basic Attack mengenai target, Fusion DMG Bonus Encore meningkat sebesar 3%, bertumpuk hingga 4 kali selama 6 dtk.

description.en: Encore additionally restores 10 Resonance Energy when casting Basic Attack Wooly Strike or Resonance Skill Energetic Welcome. This can be triggered once every 10s.
description.id: Encore memulihkan tambahan 10 Resonance Energy saat melancarkan Basic Attack Wooly Strike atau Resonance Skill Energetic Welcome. Efek ini dapat aktif sekali setiap 10 dtk.

description.en: The DMG multiplier of Heavy Attack Cloudy Frenzy and Heavy Attack Cosmos Rupture is increased by 40%.
description.id: Pengali DMG Heavy Attack Cloudy Frenzy dan Heavy Attack Cosmos Rupture meningkat sebesar 40%.

description.en: Heavy Attack Cosmos Rupture increases the Fusion DMG Bonus of all team members by 20% for 30s.
description.id: Heavy Attack Cosmos Rupture meningkatkan Fusion DMG Bonus seluruh anggota tim sebesar 20% selama 30 dtk.

description.en: Resonance Skill DMG Bonus is increased by 35%.
description.id: Resonance Skill DMG Bonus meningkat sebesar 35%.

description.en: During Resonance Liberation Cosmos Rave, Encore gains 1 stack(s) of "Lost Lamb" every time she deals damage, each stack increasing her ATK by 5% for 10s, stacking up to 5 time(s).
description.id: Selama Resonance Liberation Cosmos Rave, Encore mendapat 1 stack "Lost Lamb" setiap kali memberikan damage, setiap stack meningkatkan ATK-nya sebesar 5% selama 10 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 5 kali.
